description: Fix school context loading across all admin pages (staff, students, academic, results). Replace .single() with .maybeSingle() on school_id lookups. Distinguish loading state from error state. Pages currently show 'Your account is not linked to a school' error even when school_id exists due to PGRST116 errors on missing records and improper error handling during loading.
steps: In src/app/school-admin/staff/page.tsx, in the useEffect that calls getCurrentSchool (around line 540), change the users table query from .single() to .maybeSingle(). Check error only for non-PGRST116 errors. Only show toast.error after fetch completes and school_id is null (not during loading). Leave loading state unset until fetch completes.
In src/app/school-admin/students/page.tsx, apply the same fix to the school context useEffect (pattern is identical).

In src/app/school-admin/academic/page.tsx, apply the same fix. Also find the schools table query around line 68 and change .single() to .maybeSingle(). Find the academic_terms query around line 123 and change .single() to .maybeSingle().
In src/app/school-admin/results/page.tsx, apply the same fix to the school context fetch. Find any .single() calls on school-related queries and change to .maybeSingle().
acceptance_criteria: All four pages load without 'Your account is not linked to a school' error when user has valid school_id
During loading state, no error message appears (loading spinner only)
If school_id is genuinely null after fetch, toast.error shows (but this should not happen for valid users)
No PGRST116 errors in browser console
Dropdowns/data load immediately after school context is set
verification: Login as SCHOOL_ADMIN user with valid school_id
Verify each page loads with data (not showing error)
Check browser DevTools console for no errors
Verify school context (school_id) is set correctly in component state
